name: Agra Fort
description: Agra Fort is a vast red sandstone fortress in Agra, northern India, rebuilt by Emperor Akbar in the 1560s and early 1570s. Behind its towering walls, Shah Jahan later added white marble palaces and mosques, and the Mughal emperors lived here for decades. It stands about 2.5 kilometres from the Taj Mahal, beside the Yamuna river.
